sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Ethnohistorical/classificatory study; the only linguistic material is Tessmann's 35-word list reproduced with Tessmann's acute accent marks (Table 2, pp. 131-132: ináwa, áwua, hívui, rawué, hóxo, varíxi, íro, mítše, puö́xe, yáta, kuáhi, mátsi, mankó, tšinán, óma..) and Smyth & Lowe's 12 star names (Table 3, pp. 133-134). No word 'acento' or any stress/prosody remark; the notes only explain the 'şh' symbol. Fleck states (p. 110) that no detailed study of the people or language has ever been published.
